title: Update Mechanism Overview
description: Tauri-plugin-based release checking and installation with explicit state machine.
body: Finding out that a newer OpenKaava exists, and replacing this one with it. The mechanism is `tauri-plugin-updater`: it fetches the `latest.json` named in `plugins.updater.endpoints`, verifies its minisign signature against `plugins.updater.pubkey`, downloads the NSIS installer and runs it. What is here is the part that plugin has no opinion about — when a check happens, what the interface is told while it is happening, and what a failure reads like on screen. Driven from Rust, not from the webview — Rust owns everything touching the machine, and this downloads a file and runs an installer.
